luxR TODO

Source: TODO.md

This backlog records issues found during a package-wide review of the R API, bundled data, Shiny application, tests, and documentation. Correctness, reproducibility, and data integrity take precedence over adding features.

P0: correctness and data-integrity blockers

Enforce dimensionally valid spectrum arithmetic

Acceptance criteria:

  • Incompatible addition and subtraction raise a specific error.
  • Reflectance times irradiance remains irradiance with an irradiance unit.
  • Reflectance times radiance remains radiance with a radiance unit.
  • No arithmetic path silently drops or invents dimensions.

Affected code: R/lux_spectrum.R.

Correct energy-to-photon conversion for radiance

Acceptance criteria:

  • Converting mW/m2/sr/nm neither loses /sr nor produces a 1000-fold error.
  • Round-trip conversions retain quantity, unit, wavelength grid, and values within a documented numerical tolerance.

Affected code: R/n2W_spec_irradiance.R, R/lux_spectrum.R.

Make lux_spectrum fail fast at construction

Acceptance criteria:

  • Descending or duplicated wavelength grids cannot yield negative or duplicated integrals.
  • Invalid spectra are rejected before they reach PAR, lux, propagation, or perception calculations.
  • Constructor validation is covered by boundary and malformed-input tests.

Affected code: R/lux_spectrum.R, integration helpers.

Correct biological channel definitions and defaults

Acceptance criteria:

  • The Shiny app cannot silently model rods, ipRGCs, or fluorescent proteins as ordinary chromatic channels.
  • Each receptor row has a traceable source and a documented biological role.
  • Tests distinguish mathematical agreement from biological validation.

Affected code: R/colour_jnd.R, R/species_perception.R, R/detectability.R, inst/app/server.R, bundled species data.

Fix Shiny source-depth semantics

Acceptance criteria:

  • Selecting an underwater 10 m source and a 5 m target cannot be presented as an unqualified spectrum at 5 m.
  • The app and vignette produce consistent results from the same assumptions.

Affected code: R/solar_irradiance.R, R/depth_propagation.R, inst/app/global.R, inst/app/server.R.

P1: scientific calculation and interpretation

Repair photometric integration

Acceptance criteria:

  • A monochromatic 1 W/m2 input at 555 nm gives the documented photopic maximum under the chosen integration convention.
  • Energy at 300 nm contributes zero photopic illuminance.
  • Reflectance and radiance objects are rejected by irradiance-only functions.

Affected code: R/irradiance2lux.R, R/irradiance2lux_FUN.R, scotopic helpers.

Correct quantum-catch units and labels

Acceptance criteria:

  • No output claims an absolute receptor photon rate without the geometry and efficiency terms required to calculate one.
  • Molar and photon-count examples differ by the correct Avogadro scaling.

Affected code: R/species_perception.R, inst/app/server.R, examples and vignettes.

Define the limits of detection-range calculations

Acceptance criteria:

  • Users can distinguish an approximate teaching estimate from a validated prediction.
  • Invalid parameters cannot return negative or infinite ranges as ordinary results.

Affected code: R/detectability.R, R/visibility.R, R/geometry.R, Shiny Detection tab.

Bound Jerlov interpolation and extrapolation

Affected code: R/jerlov_Kd.R, bundled Jerlov data, Shiny propagation paths.

Clarify and validate the polarization model

Affected code: polarization functions and their documentation.

P1: import, provenance, and reproducibility

Make spectrum readers strict and calibration-aware

Acceptance criteria:

  • Raw counts cannot be displayed as absolute lux or photon flux.
  • Import errors identify file, format, row/field, and declared calibration.
  • No reader silently repairs scientific input data.

Affected code: R/spectrum_readers.R, R/trios.R, R/read_spectrum.R, R/app_support.R, Shiny upload workflow.

Add reproducible dataset provenance

Affected code: bundled .rda data, R/data.R, inst/REFERENCES.bib, build and CI scripts.

P2: app and documentation consistency

Align the documented and actual Shiny application

Affected code: README.md, R/run_app.R, inst/app/ui.R, inst/app/server.R, NEWS.md.

Rebuild the pkgdown site without stale artifacts

Implementation was merged in PR #86. The pkgdown build and all four platform/version R CMD check jobs passed.

Affected code: docs/, _pkgdown.yml, .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml, README and roxygen documentation.

Product boundary and complementary integrations

luxR should focus on transparent underwater spectral propagation and creation of perception-ready light environments. It should complement specialist packages instead of duplicating their mature capabilities.

Proposed positioning:

luxR is a lightweight, R-native teaching and field workflow that converts measured or reference underwater spectra into depth-dependent, perception-ready illuminants and hands them off to specialist animal-vision tools.

Verification required before release
